other_conditions: Startup must be certified by the Start‑up Promotion Cell (SPC) and possess a valid start‑up certificate number
Expenditure must be incurred after the notification of Goa Start‑up Policy 2017 and within the policy’s validity period
Expenditure must be paid digitally; if digital payment is not possible, SPC may approve based on its due diligence
Application must be made within six months of incurring the relevant expenditure
benefits_summary: Grants 30% of loan interest up to ₹5 lakh per annum for up to two years for up to three recommended startups, and 10% up to ₹2 lakh per annum for two years for other startups.
